name: Autoboat
description: Autoboat is an official Meta partner offering an all-in-one WhatsApp Business platform with Official WhatsApp API, interactive WhatsApp Mini-Apps, in-chat UPI/Card payments, shared multi-agent inbox, AI chatbots, lead CRM with source attribution, and marketing automation. Businesses can launch storefronts, bookings, forms, and payments directly inside WhatsApp, run broadcasts, route conversations by department, embed a WhatsApp web chat widget, and track ROI end-to-end, all without coding.

events.d: Send text, media (image, video, audio, document), location, reactions, or interactive messages (buttons, lists, CTAs) to a contact or phone number via WhatsApp.
Send a pre-approved WhatsApp template to a contact or phone number. Optionally populate template variables and include header media, location, or button URLs.
